safety.description: Blend of crime rate, pedestrian/cyclist crash rate, FEMA natural hazard risk, and chronic disease burden (all inverted: lower = higher safety)

opportunity.description: Blend of permit rate (more development = higher opportunity), unemployment rate (more unemployment = lower opportunity), and Zillow for-sale housing inventory per capita (fewer listings = tighter/more in-demand market = higher opportunity)

amenities.formula: 100 - normalize(request_rate_pc) + normalize(housing_rate_pc + schools_pc + grocery_pc + restaurants_pc + healthcare_pc)
amenities.description: Amenities & Services: inverse of service requests, plus housing production per capita, each weighted equally to a blended OpenStreetMap amenity-access sub-score (schools/groceries/restaurants/healthcare, each 0.25 so the group totals the same weight as one administrative source). Trails, transit, and traffic moved to the Transportation component; chronic disease burden moved to Safety.

transportation.description: Trail/path length and transit stop rate (direct) minus traffic volume (inverted), blended 70/30 with a Zillow-style Walk/Bike Score (core/walk_score.py: distance-decay proximity to groceries/restaurants/transit/schools/healthcare + street-intersection density + trail km, computed separately from the per-source pipeline)

affordability.formula: average(100 - normalize(median_home_value), 100 - normalize(median_gross_rent), normalize(median_household_income), 100 - normalize(poverty_rate), 100 - normalize(housing_cost_burden_rate), normalize(homeownership_rate))
affordability.description: Census ACS housing cost burden: lower home values/rent/poverty/cost-burden and higher household income/homeownership relative to other districts raise this index

normalization.description: Min-max scaling to 0-100 range within each component
